commit 935f4a2e07b935af14eb02c826f6e08117511d88
Author:     Evandro Baginski <ebaginski@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Sun Jun 14 00:20:58 2026 +0200
Commit:     Evandro Baginski <ebaginski@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Sun Jun 14 00:20:58 2026 +0200

    Bug 2045127 - Update tb-flatpak Docker image to use official flatpak-builder-lint image r=sking
    
    
    Switch the base image from freedesktopsdk/flatpak to the upstream
    flathub/flatpak-builder-lint image, which includes flatpak-builder-lint
    directly. Drop the manual pip install step and the deprecated MAINTAINER
    instruction in favor of using label[1].
    
    [1] https://docs.docker.com/reference/build-checks/maintainer-deprecated/
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D306502

diff --git a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile
index 9248c9acc2e..33a55be60da 100644
--- a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile
+++ b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
-FROM freedesktopsdk/flatpak:25.08-x86_64
-MAINTAINER daniel@thunderbird.net
+FROM ghcr.io/flathub/flatpak-builder-lint@sha256:89e3512219fcad8caac39a8c7088748d0a9077396845610b0976cb5e5aead91c
+LABEL org.opencontainers.image.authors="daniel@thunderbird.net"
 
 # Create scripts directory
 RUN mkdir /scripts/
@@ -27,8 +27,5 @@ RUN /scripts/make_venv.sh /scripts/fluent_requirements.txt
 RUN ["gcc", "-Wall", "-shared", "-o", "/scripts/close_range.so", "/scripts/close_range.c"]
 ENV LD_PRELOAD /scripts/close_range.so
 
-# Install flatpak-builder-lint
-RUN pip3 install git+https://github.com/flathub-infra/flatpak-builder-lint.git
-
 # Set a default command useful for debugging
 CMD ["/bin/bash", "--login"]
title: Bug 2045127 - Update tb-flatpak Docker image to use official flatpak-builder-lint image r=sking
